integrity: Theorem supported by an explicit 82-bit witness, finite integer necklace-block recurrence, exhaustive 120-case equality exclusion, and replayable standard-library checker; an alternate integer-programming check is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for linear binary superstrings of all length-10 squares with five-bit roots; no claims for other root lengths, circular covers, or classification of all optima. Historical priority beyond inspected sources remains qualified.
title: Exact minimum linear superstring length for all binary five-bit squares
